verdict.rationale: Gemini's Deep Research is documented as doing "in-depth and real-time research" with Google Search as the default source, which covers answers grounded in current web results. Nothing in the evidence documents citations or links back to sources, and grounding is only shown for the Deep Research mode, not ordinary chat answers. Missing for 10: documented source citations or attributions in answers, evidence of web grounding in standard chat responses, independent or hands-on corroboration of grounded, cited answers.
